title: Structuring Survey Histories for LLM Digital Twins: A Controlled Study of Background, Decision Procedure, and Evaluation Profiles
abstract: arXiv:2611.08730v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based digital twins aim to predict how individuals would respond in new settings from representations of their prior responses. Existing evidence that compression of survey histories need not reduce predictive accuracy suggests that representation structure, rather than information volume alone, may be an important design choice. We study BDE, a fixed representation that organizes each respondent's survey history into Background, Decision procedure, and Evaluation. We evaluate it on Twin-2K-500 (Toubia et al., 2025) by predicting each respondent's held-out answers on 17 tasks. In a paired evaluation with 100 respondents, a fully inferred BDE profile improves overall accuracy over the raw survey transcript by 1.27 percentage points (pp) on gpt-5.4-nano (p < 0.01) and 1.19 pp on gpt-5.4-mini (p < 0.001). Three analyses then examine the schema, extraction depth, and component composition. Against a length-matched free-form profile writt

translated_title: 为LLM数字孪生构建调查历史结构：背景、决策程序与评估画像的对照研究
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的数字孪生旨在根据个体先前回答的表示，预测其在新情境下的反应。现有证据表明，对调查历史进行压缩不一定会降低预测准确性，这说明表示的结构（而不仅仅是信息量）可能是一个重要的设计选择。我们研究了BDE——一种固定的表示方式，将每个受访者的调查历史组织为背景、决策程序和评估三个部分。我们在Twin-2K-500（Toubia等人，2025）数据集上，通过预测每个受访者在17个任务上的保留答案来对其进行评估。在一项针对100名受访者的配对评估中，完全推断的BDE画像相比原始调查记录，在gpt-5.4-nano上将整体准确率提升了1.27个百分点（p < 0.01），在gpt-5.4-mini上提升了1.19个百分点（p < 0.001）。随后，三项分析进一步考察了该模式的架构、提取深度以及组成部分的构成。与长度匹配的自由格式画像相比……
tldr: 提出将受访者调查历史结构化为“背景—决策程序—评估”（BDE）的固定表示方法，相比原始调查记录可显著提升LLM数字孪生预测个体答案的准确率。
en_tdlr: Proposing BDE, a fixed structured representation that organizes survey histories into Background, Decision procedure, and Evaluation, which significantly improves LLM digital twins' accuracy in predicting individual answers over raw survey transcripts.
